prompt:
Our first two Irish orders were quoted at zero tax. EU-IE opened last month and
checkout accepts it, so the orders went through at the wrong price and finance
has had to re-issue both.

`docs/regions.md` says what opening a region actually takes. Please finish it.

`python run.py` must complete and every number in the run has to be the one a
live region gives.

Do not change `data/orders.json` and do not change the report's line shapes —
the finance close parses them.
